gates.label: Inventory and rights
gates.requirement: Every deliverable in the manifest exists, is versioned, and Starlight holds the rights to sell it.

gates.label: Merchant eligibility
gates.requirement: Merchant-of-record account approved for digital goods in the launch regions, with the trading entity verified.

gates.label: Tax and consumer terms
gates.requirement: VAT handling, consumer withdrawal consent, licence and refund terms published and linked from checkout.

gates.label: Payment webhook
gates.requirement: Provider webhook with signature verification deployed, secret configured, replay test passed.

gates.label: Idempotent entitlement
gates.requirement: Entitlements created once per payment event, duplicates ignored, audit row written.

gates.label: Private versioned delivery
gates.requirement: Signed, expiring download for the entitled version; transactional email sent and logged.

gates.label: Recovery paths
gates.requirement: Failure, duplicate, delayed, declined, replay, refund and revocation paths exercised end to end in test mode.

gates.label: Support flow
gates.requirement: Support inbox, response target and escalation owner confirmed; recovery guide published.

gates.label: Admin reconciliation and audit
gates.requirement: Payments, entitlements, deliveries and refunds reconcile from the provider report to the audit trail.

gates.label: Customer licence portal
gates.requirement: Customers can re-download the entitled version and see licence state without emailing support.
